versions.description: Daily quests: every day each player gets a few random quests from a pool you configure, like kill 30 enemies, play 60 minutes, send 10 chat messages, buy something in the shop, earn currency or use a command (claim daily, vote). Progress is tracked from game events, players get a PM at milestones and are paid currency and/or items on completion. Players see their quests with /quests and can swap one with /questreroll for a fee. Quest types your game doesn't emit can be switched off.

commands.name: quests
commands.helpText: Shows your daily quests, progress and rewards.

commands.name: questreroll
commands.description: Swap one open quest for another (costs currency)
commands.helpText: Swap one of today's open quests for a random other one. Usage: questreroll <number from the quests list>.

arguments.name: number
arguments.helpText: Quest number from the quests list
